cim: 4K Steelbook of ‘A.I. — Artificial Intelligence’ Due Dec. 15 From Alliance
cim_eredeti: 4K Steelbook of ‘A.I. — Artificial Intelligence’ Due Dec. 15 From Alliance
szoveg_eredeti:
Director Steven Spielberg’s 2001 sci-fi film A.I. — Artificial Intelligence will be released on 4K Ultra HD disc in a limited-edition Steelbook edition Dec. 15 by Paramount and Alliance Home Entertainment.

The film is set in a future world where humans share aspects of their lives with companion robots called Mechas. But when an advanced prototype robot child named David (Haley Joel Osment) is programmed to show unconditional love, his human family isn’t prepared for the consequences.

The cast also includes Jude Law, Frances O’Connor, Brendan Gleeson and William Hurt.

The two disc set includes a 4K disc of the film, and a regular Blu-ray Disc of the film with bonus materials including several legacy behind-the-scenes featurettes, and two of the film’s trailers.
